description.en: Schematic coastal-defence line synthesising early Ming coastal garrisons, inspection stations and naval bases from Liaodong to Hainan; not a precise snapshot of any single year.

name.en: Ming coastal defence line (Taiwan and Penghu)

description.en: Schematic coastal-defence line linking the Fujian coast to Penghu and looping around Taiwan; it shows Taiwan and Penghu within the Ming south-eastern coastal-defence sphere, not an administrative territory.
